reply.emotion: warm and familiar, talking about family gatherings
notes: In Mexico and many other Spanish-speaking countries, 'caer en el primo' or similar expressions are less common than simply calling someone 'primo' affectionately, though 'primo' can also mean a naive person who is easily fooled in colloquial speech.
